name: The Star Princess and the Treacherous Knight
source:
"We abide by the will of stars, the will of the Goddess of Stars."

On a certain night, the rebels plan to assassinate the royal family. The princess and her knight are having a conversation.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/the-star-princess-and-the-treacherous-knight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我们遵守星辰的意志，星辰女神的意志。”

某个夜晚，叛军计划刺杀王室。公主和她的骑士正在交谈。

[来自[url=https://altila.itch.io/the-star-princess-and-the-treacherous-knight]itch.io[/url]]
